_help: Transcriptions of card backs (Ian's custom cards: bios and stats in his own words), shown in the card viewer under "Read the back" and read aloud by screen readers. Key: the Drive file ID of the card's BACK scan (stays the same when a file is renamed); text keyed to a front image is ignored, and the button only shows while the back is on screen. "name" is just a reminder of which card it is. "text": paragraphs separated by a blank line; a line starting with "## " is a small heading; lines with " | " between values form a small table (first such line is the header row).
